filename_rule: Filename frame id MUST equal callback frame id; a mismatch records CAPTURE_FRAME_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH
equal_counts_are_not_sync: test_cross_sensor_mismatched_frames_detected: 3 frames each over {1,2,3} and {2,3,4} intersects to {2,3}. test_camera_frame_n_with_lidar_n_plus_one: {5,6} vs {6,7} intersects to {6}.
invalidating_cases: camera frame N with LiDAR N+1 (no common frames)
binding_follows_actual_write: _run_write_job binds to the Path returned by the writer when it returns one, so a substituted filename is detected rather than masked by the requested out_path
authority: actual CARLA callback data.frame; not world tick at observation time, not aggregate counts, not file-count coincidence
